thread.title: PHOTOS: Apple biggest, most expensive iPhone yet and new Watch with FDA approval

author: wn.com
title: PHOTOS: Apple biggest, most expensive iPhone yet and new Watch with FDA approval
text: Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) executives took to the stage at the company's Cupertino, California, headquarters on Wednesday to unveil a lineup of bigger, pricier iPhones and a revamped Apple Watch with new health and medical features and a first-of-its-kind approval from federal drug regulators. The company unveiled a new Apple Watch with an electrical heart rate sensor and new software to detect irregular heart rhythms.
